# VOGIM Prayer Land

> VOGIM Prayer Land is an online deliverance and prayer ministry rooted in Ikorodu, Lagos, Nigeria. Prayer, deliverance and counselling are free. The ministry is led by Prophet Olaofe Oladele, Founder & General Overseer, and was founded in May 2021.

## Ministry and prayer

- [Home](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/): Ministry overview, service information and ways to request prayer.
- [Online deliverance](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/online-deliverance/): How private online deliverance sessions work.
- [Healing ministry](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/healing/): Free healing prayer with optional health details and a continue-with-your-doctor note.
- [Marital settlement](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/marital-settlement/): Prayer and guidance for marriages, relationships and families.
- [Dream interpretation](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/dream-interpretation/): Private dream interpretation requests.
- [Prayer request](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/prayer-request/): Send a free, private online prayer request.
- [How requests work](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/how-requests-work/): Who receives requests, what happens next and privacy choices.
- [FAQs](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/faq/): Answers about free prayer requests, Zoom services, deliverance sessions, healing prayer, giving safely and privacy.

## Services and visit

- [Services and Zoom](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/services/): Weekly times in WAT, visitor-local times, Zoom links and calendar files.
- [Plan your visit](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/visit/): Ikorodu address, Sunday worship time and map link.
- [About](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/about/): Ministry story, founder and threefold work.
- [Leaders](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/leaders/): Prophet Olaofe Oladele, Founder & General Overseer.

## Trust and giving

- [Official channels and scam notice](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/notice/): Verify websites, giving, WhatsApp and social channels.
- [Give](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/give/): Voluntary giving through the official hosted checkout.
- [Giving and refund policy](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/refund-policy/): Refund exceptions, windows and request form.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/privacy-policy/): Data use, retention, processors and visitor rights.
- [Privacy requests](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/privacy-requests/): Ask for access, correction, deletion or withdrawal of consent.
- [Cookie policy](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/cookie-policy/): Cookie and browser-storage choices.
- [Complaints](https://www.vogimprayerland.org/complaints/): Raise a concern privately.
